title: TSAI Trust Authority HSM Attestation
description: The signed HSM attestation a Trust Authority publishes at /.well-known/tsai-ta-hsm-attestation (Section 7.11). auditor, auditStandard, and reportUrl are optional so a self-attestation, which lacks a third party, still validates; an independent-audit MUST name an auditor and a standard (see allOf).

taIdentifier.description: The Trust Authority HTTPS issuer identifier the attestation is for

attestationType.description: Assurance level: independent-audit (third party verified HSM use, strongest), vendor-attestation (the HSM vendor confirms residency), or self-attestation (weakest, transitional)

auditor.description: The third party that performed the audit; required for independent-audit

auditStandard.description: The standard the audit was against, e.g. SOC2-Type2; required for independent-audit

scope.description: What the attestation covers, e.g. signing-key generation, storage, and use

reportUrl.description: Link to the audit report, where one is published

nextAuditDate.description: When the attestation is next due; kept current within 18 months

proof.description: The signature over the attestation, made with the current signing key

kid.description: Identifier of the signing key within the issuer key set
